address: Margaret - Hôtel Chouleur, 6 rue Fresque, Nîmes, 30000, France
bio: This magnificent 15C town house is home to a fine dining restaurant which sports a plush velvety interior and a huge counter separating the room and the kitchen. Always aligned with the seasons, the score demonstrates a fusion of Mediterranean influences and a few globetrotting notes that come to fruition in creative, gutsy dishes. In fine weather, tables are laid in the large courtyard....
